summary: Iteration 2 end-to-end pass. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (13 regression from iter1 + 5 new for real monitoring, deep drill-down, AI codegen). Frontend: real monitoring flow (endpoints toggle -> config editor -> save & probe -> LIVE cyan badge with real latency ~157ms + toast), analyzer drill-down (backend node -> drawer with 15+ ENDPOINTS + drill button -> subgraph -> back), Open in Builder (loads 7 nodes/6 traces preloaded, project name propagated, 'Loaded analyzed circuit' toast, scaffold export .zip download) all verified.

minor.issue: AI codegen call takes ~80s and returns 502 through the public ingress (60s ingress timeout). Backend itself completes correctly (24 files incl. models.py/schemas.py/crud.py/routers/items.py/App.jsx, X-AI-Files=18-24). Frontend polls with axios timeout=default which may error out even though backend succeeds.
Still raw dict payloads (no Pydantic schema) — carried over from iter1.
Raw dict payload accepted; no validation that config values are URLs. Non-URL strings still saved and would produce probe errors.

integration_issues.issue: Because ingress caps ~60s and LLM codegen ~80s, the axios call from the browser will error even though the backend produced a valid zip. Consider streaming/chunked response or a job-poll endpoint.

action_items: AI codegen through ingress: switch to async job pattern (POST returns job id, GET polls) OR generate the zip on backend and stream progress; current path exceeds ingress ~60s and will fail for real users via the public URL even though localhost works.
Optionally validate URL format in monitor config to give an inline error before probing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_ai_codegen swallows exceptions and returns {}; frontend can't tell if AI truly produced 0 files vs. errored (X-AI-Files=0 in both cases).
server.py:set_monitor_config uses `payload.get('config', {})` on a raw dict — no schema; a non-object config silently becomes empty.
server.py:monitor endpoint returns 'code: None' for simulated nodes but frontend badge logic only branches on source==live — acceptable but keep in sync.
MonitorPage.jsx: after saveConfig successful poll() is invoked once, but the setInterval already fires every 2s; harmless duplicate.
BuilderPage.jsx:doExport uses default axios timeout — for ai:true (up to 60-120s) should set timeout: 180000 explicitly.
seed_data_creation: Added deep analyze of gothinkster/node-express-realworld-example-app and expressjs/express in mongo. Set monitor_config on the realworld project (backend->https://example.com). TEST_scaffold & TEST_ai scaffold-only zips created (not persisted to DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration2.py hits localhost:8001 for the AI codegen test because the public ingress times out at ~60s and returns 502; backend AI codegen actually succeeds in ~80s and produces 18-24 real encapsulated files. Frontend AI Codegen button will therefore likely fail via the public URL for real users — flagged as an action item. Monitor real-probe path works: setting a URL for any node -> next /monitor poll returns source:'live' with latency_ms>0 & HTTP code.
rca of the issue: AI export 502 via public URL — cause: Kubernetes/ingress request timeout (~60s) shorter than LLM+codegen latency (~80s). Mitigation options: (a) async job (POST returns id, poll for zip), (b) stream chunks via StreamingResponse to keep the connection alive, (c) reduce codegen size / parallelize prompts.
